escalation_reason: planner stop: lag undetermined for the paged group; human decision required
findings: The alert pages on ledger-consumer, but get_consumer_lag returned lag: null for that group — the platform has no cached reading for it. Null is an unknown state, not a healthy one: it is deliberately not reported as 0 and carries no lag magnitude, so this probe neither confirms nor excludes consumer saturation.
recommendation: Confirm whether ledger-consumer still exists under that name; if it was renamed or decommissioned, retarget the paging rule at the live group, otherwise check that the consumer is started and holds a partition assignment before treating the alert as noise.
